integrity_notes: Originality is based on accessible primary-literature comparisons and published-record search, not independent priority certification; the core analytic positivity argument is included in RESULT.md.
limitations: All sample sizes are integers n>=4; parent law is uniform on exactly three distinct real support atoms; no statement for unequal masses, larger supports, or different order ranks.
The theorem concerns ordinary Pearson correlation after a common increasing transformation, not arbitrary separate transformations or maximal correlation.
The entire 2021 López-Blázquez--Salamanca-Miño article could not be inspected; only its publisher preview and abstract were available; bibliographic priority risk is retained.
Finite symbolic and exact-rational verification supplements rather than establishes the all-n analytic proof.
title: Sharp three-state extreme-order correlation for every sample size at least four
